rationales.fluency: Awkward construction with unnatural word order for expressing obligation.
rationales.grammar: Is mian dom means I wish not obligation; lean requires prepositional form; wrong tense/mood entirely.
rationales.idiom: Uses wish construction instead of idiomatic obligation expression like caithfidh me.
rationales.task_fulfillment: Fails to express obligation or necessity; meaning is altered to wish rather than must/have-to.
